summary.ja: HPCI計画を国として推進するための検討と、計画案・進捗状況の評価を行う委員会。計算資源の整備と利用をめぐる議論を、設置文書や公開会議資料からたどる。
summary.en: A MEXT committee examining national measures for the HPCI plan and evaluating proposals and progress. Its founding document and meeting materials provide a route into discussions of computing infrastructure and its use.

ja: HPCI計画の推進に必要な事項を検討。
コンソーシアムからの計画案や、計画の進捗を評価。
en: Examines matters needed to advance the HPCI plan.
Evaluates proposals from the consortium and progress of the plan.

summary.ja: HPCI計画推進委員会の下で、ポスト「京」の基本設計を評価。開発主体へのヒアリングを経て、2016年1月に基本設計に係る報告書が取りまとめられた。
summary.en: A working group under the HPCI committee reviewed the basic design of post-K. Hearings with the development organization led to a basic-design report in January 2016.

ja: 開発目的に向けた基本設計は、概ね妥当との評価。
2016年3月には、CSTI評価専門調査会で基本設計評価結果を確認。
en: The basic design was assessed as broadly appropriate for the development objectives.
In March 2016, the CSTI evaluation panel reviewed the basic-design assessment.

involvement.en: During the first secondment, responsibilities included this system-review working group, according to the author's career record. Meeting-specific responsibilities will be added progressively.
